material: Buddy Talks AUDIO FILE - cat and cake
lesson.introText:
Hey guys! I’m BUDDY! Today, we’ll separate two vowels that turn one word into a completely different one. …CAT and CAKE! The /æ/ of cat does not exist in Portuguese: snack

So we borrow the nearest sound we have, and the word turns into another one. Then fat becomes fate, and the sentence means something you never said.
buddyBaloes: Hey guys! I’m BUDDY! Today, we’ll separate two vowels that turn one word into a completely different one.
